name: Ibara
source:
The main character of one of Grimm's Fairy Tales: "Little Briar Rose".

A sleepy girl who has been given a role to fall asleep anytime and anywhere, a unique heroine who can be seen unconscious more often than awake.

Only princes or those who are recognized as princes are allowed to wake her up. The small moments she spent awake are used for her private time.

Has been seen napping everywhere.

"Waiting around all the time is boring... I want to experience the newlywed life with the prince..."

[Edited from [url=http://yumemiru.nexton-net.jp/gbm-grimm/package/#character]Official Website[/url]]
